comment: C-first source route for steal.c:stealamulet through the Wizard role's quest nemesis, the Dark One. Raise hero level for survivability, wish the real Amulet, create the hostile Dark One, inspect the C placement, then allow several turns for its AT_CLAW/AD_SAMU attack to reach the steal check.
